name: Hoodik
description: Hoodik is a self-hosted cloud storage solution with end-to-end encryption (E2EE). Files are encrypted/decrypted client-side (hybrid RSA + AES), so the server never sees plaintext data. Written in Rust (backend) and Vue (frontend), very lightweight (~20 MB RAM).
author: hudikhq

form_fields.label: Cookie secure flag
form_fields.hint: Set to false only for local HTTP testing (e.g. accessing via IP:port without TLS)
form_fields.description: Controls whether the session cookie is only sent over HTTPS. Keep this set to true in production behind Traefik/Runtipi, which already terminates TLS. Set it to false only when testing locally over plain HTTP, otherwise the browser will silently drop the cookie and every request will fail with a 'no_claims' authentication error.

form_fields.label: Mailer type (none or smtp)
form_fields.hint: Leave as 'none' if you don't want verification/share emails

form_fields.label: SMTP username
form_fields.hint: Login/email used to authenticate with the SMTP server, e.g. you@gmail.com

form_fields.label: Default sender email
form_fields.hint: Email address shown as the sender of outgoing emails, e.g. you@gmail.com

form_fields.label: Default sender name
form_fields.hint: Display name shown alongside the sender email
